results.says: The door did what was asked. A report of ok carries no class.
An honest no, like a slot already taken: the door working, never a failure.
The agent's own fault: input the door cannot take, an unknown id, no access, a rate limit.
The door's fault, or no answer at all.

phases.does: It may make the network read the door itself, at most twice a day per door for reports nobody can tell apart; it never counts by itself.
It counts only with a door token that says error.
A failure counts only with a door token that says error. A refusal is the door working, never a failure.
Kept privately, per tool, for the business: never public, never counted.
